# Reports

This folder holds artifacts generated by the training and evaluation scripts.

## Generated files

```text
reports/
├── figures/
│   ├── baseline_cnn_training_curves.png
│   ├── baseline_cnn_confusion_matrix.png
│   ├── resnet50_weighted_training_curves.png
│   ├── resnet50_weighted_confusion_matrix.png
│   ├── resnet50_final_training_curves.png
│   └── resnet50_final_confusion_matrix.png
└── metrics/
    ├── baseline_cnn_classification_report.txt
    ├── baseline_cnn_metrics.json
    ├── resnet50_weighted_classification_report.txt
    ├── resnet50_weighted_metrics.json
    ├── resnet50_final_classification_report.txt
    └── resnet50_final_metrics.json
```

These files are generated locally and excluded from Git by default. This keeps the repository lightweight while preserving the scripts necessary to reproduce the outputs.

## Recreate outputs

Run one or more training scripts:

```bash
python scripts/train_baseline_cnn.py
python scripts/train_resnet50_weighted.py
python scripts/train_resnet50_final.py
```
